> Our experience with Rezolve Ai has been incredibly positive. Their team has provided outstanding support and bandwidth throughout our transition from the legacy platform to the new AI system. They’ve consistently made themselves available to answer questions, collaborate on strategy, and recommend solutions tailored to our goals. One of the most valuable aspects has been the access to robust analytics, which has empowered us to make data-driven decisions and remain agile in optimizing our site. While we’re still early in the transition, the results so far have us feeling confident and excited about what’s ahead
>
>
> **Becky Morrison** Director eCommerce, QC Supply


## **The Challenge**


After more than a decade as a Rezolve Ai customer, QC Supply had outgrown the limitations of its legacy keyword-based search experience. Delivering relevant results required ongoing manual merchandising and rule creation, placing a significant operational burden on the ecommerce team. As QC Supply’s catalog and customer needs evolved, this approach became increasingly difficult to scale while consistently helping shoppers find the right products.


## **The Solution**


QC Supply migrated from Rezolve Ai’s legacy keyword-based platform to BrainCommerce, introducing semantic AI across product discovery. The new experience understands shopper intent and product context beyond exact keyword matches, helping customers find relevant products while significantly reducing the ecommerce team’s reliance on manual merchandising rules.


## **The Results**


**•** +7% orders: More effective product discovery helped translate customer demand into purchases, driving an increase in orders.


**•** +4% average order value: Customers not only converted into more orders, but also purchased greater value per transaction with higher AOV.


**•** +11% revenue: The transition to AI-powered product discovery contributed to stronger ecommerce performance, with revenue increasing during the measured period.
